effective_yaml:
"META_DATA":
  "Name": "nvfp4_fused_moe"
  "Describe": "Routed NVFP4 mixture-of-experts forward with an explicit block-16 activation\
    \ quantize-dequantize between FC1 and FC2 and a routing-weighted BF16 sum"
  "Source": "KernelSchema@24d2b3d3ca9d4907c4e7efd9607cf78cfb1a52b2:kernel_wiki/aka-cuda-operators-20261030/operators/moe/nvfp4_fused_moe/candidate/solution.py::Model.forward"
  "Version": 3
  "Dispatch":
    "id": "mega"
    "when": "the call fixing the launch set has no ids entry in [0,expert_count),\
      \ token_count*slot_count <= 8192 and (token_count*slot_count)*hidden_dim <=\
      \ 32000000, with the single direct mega-kernel submission selected. Each replay\
      \ re-reads current ids; nonempty replays execute the direct arithmetic below,\
      \ whose general numerical acceptance is not established by the empty-routing\
      \ selection"
"REALIZATION":
  "Require":
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Math_reshape::acc32"
    - "DESIGN.Math_reshape::cnt"
    "Choice": "Allocate acc32 and cnt zeroed, and reuse their workspace only after\
      \ the preceding invocation has completed its self-clean; each token finalize\
      \ zeroes its consumed rows and resets cnt, without a memset submission"
    "Reason": "The atomic chunk accumulation and the arrival target nvt*chunk_count\
      \ are correct only against the zero baseline, and that invariant must also survive\
      \ graph capture and replay of the single submission"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::MAIN"
    "Choice": "Device-scope release and acquire memory fences around the arrival counter\
      \ after the CUDA threadFenceReduction pattern - every thread fences its acc32\
      \ reductions before the rendezvous ordering thread 0's cnt increment, and the\
      \ last-arriving worker fences again before any acc32 read"
    "Reason": "finalize_token consumes partials added by other workers' atomic reductions;\
      \ the counter ordering alone does not make those additions device-visible"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Work_schedule::MAIN"
    "Choice": "A 512-thread launch bound requiring two resident CTAs per SM, __launch_bounds__(512,\
      \ 2), with the dynamic shared image of (hidden_dim + hidden_dim/8 + 96)*4 +\
      \ 64 bytes kept inside the 48 KB default budget and no opt-in attribute"
    "Reason": "The one-wave grid cap resident_cap and the host-side eligibility gate\
      \ assume this residency envelope, and this direct form deliberately omits the\
      \ staged weight images that would need the opt-in budget"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Math_reshape::Clamp, activation and NVFP4 round trip to FP32"
    "Choice": "Hardware saturating round-to-nearest-even conversions for the quantize\
      \ step - cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2 for the group scale and cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2\
      \ for the codes"
    "Reason": "The rounding and saturation points declared for the quantize step are\
      \ those of these conversions, not of a software table"
"DESIGN":
  "Math_reshape":
    "Thesis": "FP32 SIMT evaluation over raw routes, without grouping or gathered,\
      \ packed-activation or per-route BF16 materialization. Weights decode on the\
      \ fly; route atomics and token tickets replace submission boundaries, trading\
      \ tensor-core rate and atomic traffic for one launch"
    "Rewrite":
    - "Name": "Raw route space with per-route accumulator"
      "Math": "A route r = t*slot_count + k is work, valid when ids[t,k] is in [0,\
        \ expert_count); the route_capacity routes split into chunk_count 32-wide\
        \ intermediate chunks (intermediate_dim is a multiple of 32 in the declared\
        \ domain). No grouping or gathering: route r reads its token's activation\
        \ row and its expert's weights directly.\nacc32[r,h], zero at every invocation\
        \ entry, is route r's FP32 FC2 accumulator over every hidden channel; a valid\
        \ route's chunk partials add into it by atomic FP32 addition in nondeterministic\
        \ arrival order.\ncnt[t], zero at every invocation entry, gains one arrival\
        \ per completed valid unit of token t and reaches nvt(t)*chunk_count exactly\
        \ when all of the token's partials have landed; nvt(t) is the number of valid\
        \ routes of t.\nThe ticket finalize zeroes the consumed acc32 rows and resets\
        \ cnt[t], so both buffers end each invocation as they began and no zeroing\
        \ submission exists; a token with nvt(t) = 0 keeps zero rows and never triggers\
        \ a ticket.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "route_capacity":
          "meaning": "Allocated rows of the route-indexed space"
          "value": "token_count*slot_count"
        "chunk_count":
          "meaning": "32-wide intermediate chunks of one route"
          "value": "intermediate_dim/32"
        "acc32":
          "meaning": "FP32 FC2 accumulator of one raw route"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "cnt":
          "meaning": "Unit arrival counter of one token"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "nvt":
          "meaning": "Valid routes of one token"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Group routes by expert into tiles; materialize gathered operands,\
          \ packed activation and per-route BF16 results across separate submissions"
        "Gain": "No writes to grouped-route intermediates; one submission, while the\
          \ source workspace still allocates unused route, act and rout slabs"
        "Cost": "0 -> route_capacity*hidden_dim*4 bytes of acc32 materialization;\
          \ finalize adds one read and one zeroing pass, hidden_dim*4 bytes each per\
          \ valid route"
    - "Name": "Exact per-token activation decode"
      "Math": "x_dec[t,h] = hidden_value[t,h], the Contract's exact decode (E2M1 level\
        \ of each payload nibble times the exact FP32 value of its 16-channel E4M3\
        \ scale byte) in FP32; the product needs at most 6 significand bits, so the\
        \ image is exact.\nA worker forms it when its unit sequence reaches a token\
        \ other than the one decoded last and reuses it over every later unit of that\
        \ token; the range is contiguous over ascending routes, so each worker decodes\
        \ each token at most once. Workers visiting one token form identical private\
        \ copies; no global activation operand exists.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "x_dec":
          "meaning": "Exact FP32 decode of one token's activation row"
          "shape":
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
          "retention": "keep_value (t)"
    - "Name": "Block-factored SIMT FP32 FC1 slice"
      "Math": "For a valid route r = t*slot_count + k of chunk s, e = ids[t,k], i0\
        \ = 32*s, the slice forms the FC1 pair of every offset il < 32 against the\
        \ logical rows u = i0+il (up) and g = intermediate_dim+i0+il (gate) of expert\
        \ e. For a row L, block b and chain q:\n  even[b] = sum32 over m = 0..7 of\
        \ x_dec[t,16b+2m] * c1[L,16b+2m]\n  odd[b] = sum32 over m = 0..7 of x_dec[t,16b+2m+1]\
        \ * c1[L,16b+2m+1]\n  chain[q] = the sum over j = 0..hidden_dim/512-1 ascending\
        \ of fma32(sf1[L,32*j+q], even[32*j+q] + odd[32*j+q], partial), from 0\n \
        \ dot = sum32 over q = 0..31 of chain[q], a five-step XOR butterfly\nup_r[il]\
        \ is dot at L = u and gate_r[il] is dot at L = g, the Contract's up[t,k,i0+il]\
        \ and gate[t,k,i0+il], one unit's values. hidden_dim is a multiple of 512\
        \ in the declared domain. c1[L,h] and sf1[L,b] are the prepared E2M1 code\
        \ level of row L at channel h and its exact E4M3 block scale at b = floor(h/16);\
        \ their product is the Contract's w1[e][L,h], addressed by prepared_row and\
        \ the 128x4 swizzle.\n"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Accumulate": "Even and odd sums are ascending 8-term fma32 chains; x_dec\
          \ times a code is exact (<= 8 significand bits); dot closes as a five-step\
          \ XOR butterfly"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Block-scaled tensor-core products over 128-row route tiles of\
          \ a pre-gathered activation operand"
        "Gain": "No gathering, tile map or staged operand images; weights stream straight\
          \ from the prepared layout; one decode image serves every chunk of a token"
        "Cost": "2*hidden_dim FMAs per (up,gate) pair replace tensor cores; each route\
          \ reads its expert's FC1 rows alone, ~1.1*intermediate_dim*hidden_dim bytes"
    - "Name": "Clamp, activation and NVFP4 round trip to FP32"
      "Math": "For chunk channel c < 32, up = up_r[c], gate = gate_r[c], alpha = gemm1_alpha[e],\
        \ beta = gemm1_beta[e], limit = gemm1_clamp_limit[e] when present:\n  up_c\
        \ = min(max(up, -limit), limit), gate_c = min(gate, limit) when present, else\
        \ both unchanged\n  activation_type 3:  v = (gate_c * sig(alpha*gate_c)) *\
        \ (up_c + beta)\n  activation_type 10: v = (alpha * th(gate_c*rcp_rn(alpha)))\
        \ * sig(gate_c) * (beta * th(up_c*rcp_rn(beta)))\n  sig(x) = rcp_approx(1\
        \ + exp2_approx_ftz(x*L2E)); th(y) = fma32(sig(y+y), 2, -1); L2E = fp32(-1.44269504)\n\
        Group g in {0,1} quantizes its channels c = 16g..16g+15 independently:\n \
        \ amax[g] = max abs(v) over the group, an order-free butterfly max tree\n\
        \  sf[g] = fp32(fp8_e4m3fn(min(amax[g] * fp32(1/6), 448))), RNE saturating,\
        \ read back exactly\n  code[c] = e2m1_rne(v * rcp_rn(max(sf[g], 2^-126))),\
        \ RNE saturating\n  aq[c] = e2m1_level(code[c]) * sf[g], exact; when sf[g]\
        \ = 0 a signed zero; aq[c] is the Contract's act_q[t,k,i0+c], living only\
        \ as one unit's shared FP32 numbers\n"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Approx": "sig and th use ex2.approx.ftz and rcp.approx with unfolded prescales;\
          \ source comments report sampled estimates, not a domain-wide bound"
        "Accumulate": "Quantize multiplies by rcp_rn(max(sf,2^-126)) instead of dividing;\
          \ fp32(1/6) is rounded; dequantize is exact"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Store the activation as packed E2M1 payload plus E4M3 scales\
          \ in global memory for a later tensor-core FC2 submission"
        "Gain": "The activation lives as 32 shared FP32 values per unit; packed global\
          \ writes and reads of 9/16 byte per element are removed"
        "Cost": "One exact dequantize multiply per element, and FC2 consumes FP32\
          \ activations, giving up the packed tensor-core operand path"
    - "Name": "FC2 chunk partials merged by route atomics"
      "Math": "For every hidden channel h and chunk s of a valid route r with e =\
        \ ids[t,k], and every intermediate channel i of the chunk:\n  w2d[i] = c2[i]\
        \ * fp32(sf2[i]), the E2M1 level of the prepared FC2 payload code of output\
        \ row h at channel i times its exact E4M3 scale at block floor(i/16), half_row\
        \ the identity\n  chunk_sum = sum32 over i = 32s..32s+31 ascending of w2d[i]\
        \ * aq[i-32s]\nacc32[r,h] receives chunk_sum of every chunk by atomic FP32\
        \ addition in nondeterministic arrival order; within a chunk the 32 products\
        \ form one ascending fma32 chain, so after all chunk_count arrivals acc32[r,h]\
        \ is the Contract's FC2 inner sum at chunk granularity order.\n"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Accumulate": "32 sequential fma32 per channel and chunk; w2d and aq are exact,\
          \ so only additions round; the Contract fixes this sum's FP32 domain, not\
          \ its order"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Materialize every route's FC2 result as BF16 globally and read\
          \ it back slot_count times in a separate reduction submission"
        "Gain": "Per-route BF16 writes and reads are removed; partials fold into acc32,\
          \ while the source's allocated rout slab is unused"
        "Cost": "0 -> chunk_count atomic full-hidden-row writes per valid route, <=\
          \ route_capacity*chunk_count*hidden_dim*4 bytes; chunk arrival order nondeterministic"
    - "Name": "Ticket-gated routing reduction with self-clean"
      "Math": "The unit whose cnt[t] increment returns nvt(t)*chunk_count - 1 completes\
        \ token t, the arrival protocol making every route's acc32 device-visible\
        \ first. With r_j = t*slot_count + k_j the j-th valid route in ascending slot\
        \ order, for every h:\n  acc[t,h] = the sum over j = 0..nvt(t)-1 ascending\
        \ of fma32(fp32(bf16_rne(acc32[r_j,h])), scores[t,k_j], partial), from 0\n\
        \  output[t,h] = bf16(acc[t,h]), round to nearest even\nbf16_rne(acc32[r_j,h])\
        \ is the Contract's per-route BF16 materialization, formed in registers and\
        \ never stored; these are the Contract's acc and output with the route sum\
        \ ascending, one fma32 per term. The worker then zeroes the acc32 elements\
        \ it read and resets cnt[t] (self-clean).\nA token with nvt(t) = 0 never triggers\
        \ a ticket: the preparation pass writes hidden_dim zero BF16 elements to the\
        \ row of every all-invalid token. Every output element is written exactly\
        \ once, into the caller's output_buffer.\n"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "A separate reduction submission summing the materialized per-route\
          \ BF16 rows"
        "Gain": "No extra submission; each acc32 element is read exactly once and\
          \ zeroed in place"
        "Cost": "A cross-worker ticket per unit (device fence, atomic increment, two\
          \ rendezvous) and a strided 4-channel finalize window per thread"
  "Work_schedule":
    "Thesis": "One barrier-free submission replaces the node chain - one homogeneous\
      \ worker program over contiguous slices of the raw (route, chunk) space, coupled\
      \ only by per-route FP32 atomics and per-token tickets, no grid barrier or memset.\
      \ Node cadence dominates this tiny routed scope; SIMT FP32 is the price"
    "Step":
      "MAIN":
        "Describe": "Per valid-route unit - FC1 slice, act QDQ, atomic FC2 partial\
          \ into acc32, ticket; the token's last arrival reduces acc32 into its output\
          \ row"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "Before the unit loop each worker zeroes route-less output rows\
            \ and takes the census; an invalid route's unit produces nothing and skips\
            \ the ticket"
          "Partition":
            "route":
              "meaning": "Raw route slot r = token*slot_count + slot"
              "size": "route_capacity"
              "tile": 1
            "chunk":
              "meaning": "32-wide intermediate channel slice of one route"
              "size": "chunk_count"
              "tile": 1
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "acc32_part":
                "meaning": "FC2 partial of the unit's route over all channels"
                "shape":
                - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
                "dtype": "fp32"
              "output_row":
                "meaning": "Token output row, written only by its last arrival"
                "shape":
                - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
                "dtype": "ref:CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement::output.dtype"
            "Tile_reduction":
              "dimension": "chunk"
              "input": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::acc32"
              "output": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::acc32"
              "method": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::FC2 chunk partials merged by route\
                \ atomics"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One CTA of 512 threads, 16 homogeneous warps; resident_cap\
            \ is the literal 296, two CTAs per sm. The cap only re-partitions ranges,\
            \ not which units run"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "min(worktile_count, resident_cap)"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "units_per_worker = ceil_div(worktile_count, worker_count);\
            \ trailing workers can hold an empty sequence - they still run the preparation\
            \ pass and exit"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "route"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "chunk"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "min(worker_id*units_per_worker, worktile_count)"
              "count": "min(units_per_worker, max(0, worktile_count - worker_id*units_per_worker))"
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
    "Flow":
      "Launch":
      - "step":
        - "MAIN"
  "Tile_pipeline":
    "Thesis": "One homogeneous role of 512 threads - phases advance by CTA rendezvous\
      \ inside serial actions, the only cross-worker protocol is the fenced arrival\
      \ ticket. Operands stream from global memory with no staging ring, keeping two\
      \ CTAs resident per sm; overlap is limited to the warps' independent streams"
    "Step":
      "MAIN":
        "Index":
          "t":
            "meaning": "Local ordinal of this worker's unit sequence"
            "definition": "worktile"
        "Storage":
          "x_image":
            "meaning": "Padded FP32 decode of the current token's row"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": "hidden_dim + hidden_dim/8"
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": "(hidden_dim + hidden_dim/8)*4"
            "view":
              "x_dec": {}
          "ug_image":
            "meaning": "The chunk's 32 up/gate pairs, up even, gate odd"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 64
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 256
          "aq_image":
            "meaning": "The chunk's 32 dequantized activation values"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 32
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 128
            "view":
              "aq": {}
          "cta_scratch":
            "meaning": "Census slots, nvalid, nvt, last flag, route list"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "slot": 19
            "dtype": "int32"
            "total_size": 76
          "ticket_scores":
            "meaning": "Scores of the staged valid routes, ascending slot"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "slot": 8
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 32
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "The single homogeneous role - all 16 warps run the preparation\
                \ pass and the same unit program, with internal thread divisions named\
                \ per action"
              "Member": "warp[0:16]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "zero_output_rows":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Preparation - for every all-invalid token, strided\
                      \ by worker_id, the 512 threads write its output row as 16-byte\
                      \ zero vectors; only ids are read"
                  "census":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Valid ids are counted over the whole route space\
                      \ by warp butterflies into 16 slots; thread 0 totals them to\
                      \ nvalid and zero nvalid ends the worker"
                  "unit_head":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Recover route r and chunk s from the Worktile_order\
                      \ numbering, read ids[r] and set valid_route(t) and fresh(t)\
                      \ against the last decoded token"
                  "decode_x":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "When fresh(t) - all threads decode the token's payload\
                      \ bytes into the padded x_image slot of x_dec and thread 0 counts\
                      \ nvt; done covers the rendezvous"
                  "fc1_slice":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "16 warps take 2 (up,gate) pairs each; lanes own 16-channel\
                      \ blocks, stream weight bytes and scales, and reduce by the\
                      \ FC1 formula into ug_image"
                  "act_qdq":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Warp 0 takes the 32 chunk channels one per lane -\
                      \ clamp, activate and NVFP4 round trip by the Math step into\
                      \ aq_image; done covers the CTA rendezvous"
                  "fc2_partial":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Threads own 4-channel windows strided by 2048, run\
                      \ the ascending FC2 chain over the weight slice and aq_image,\
                      \ and red-add into the route's acc32 row"
                  "finalize_token":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Thread 0 stages the token's routes and scores; threads\
                      \ apply the Math route sum per window into the output row, zero\
                      \ acc32 as read and reset cnt"
                "signal":
                  "unit_arrived":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Every thread device-fences its acc32 adds before\
                      \ thread 0's cnt increment; the returned prior count sets the\
                      \ last-arrival flag; the winner re-fences"
            "Pipe":
            - "compute:zero_output_rows"
            - "compute:census"
            - "if(nvalid > 0)":
              - "for(t)":
                - "compute:unit_head(t)"
                - "if(valid_route(t))":
                  - "if(fresh(t))":
                    - "compute:decode_x(t)"
                  - "compute:fc1_slice(t)"
                  - "compute:act_qdq(t)"
                  - "compute:fc2_partial(t)"
                  - "signal:unit_arrived(t)"
                  - "if(last_arrival(t))":
                    - "compute:finalize_token(t)"
"CONTRACT":
  "Algorithm_requirement":
    "Constant":
      "nvfp4_block":
        "value": 16
        "meaning": "Channels sharing one NVFP4 scale factor"
      "e2m1_max":
        "value": 6
        "meaning": "Largest magnitude of a signed E2M1 code"
      "e4m3_max":
        "value": 448
        "meaning": "Largest finite fp8_e4m3fn magnitude"
    "Input":
      "topk_ids":
        "meaning": "Routing pair (expert ids, route weights) per slot"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "slot": "slot_count"
        "dtype": "tuple(int32, fp32)"
      "hidden_states":
        "meaning": "NVFP4 payload of the token activations, 2 per byte"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "packed_hidden": "hidden_dim/2"
        "dtype": "uint8"
      "hidden_states_scale":
        "meaning": "E4M3 scale per nvfp4_block hidden channels"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "hidden_block": "hidden_dim/nvfp4_block"
        "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
      "gemm1_weights":
        "meaning": "Prepared NVFP4 FC1 payload, up and gate rows"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "out": "2*intermediate_dim"
        - "packed_hidden": "hidden_dim/2"
        "dtype": "uint8"
      "gemm1_weights_scale":
        "meaning": "Prepared FC1 scales, 128x4 tiled"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "out": "2*intermediate_dim"
        - "hidden_block": "hidden_dim/nvfp4_block"
        "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
      "gemm2_weights":
        "meaning": "Prepared NVFP4 FC2 payload"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        - "packed_intermediate": "intermediate_dim/2"
        "dtype": "uint8"
      "gemm2_weights_scale":
        "meaning": "Prepared FC2 scales, 128x4 tiled"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        - "intermediate_block": "intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block"
        "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
      "gemm1_alpha":
        "meaning": "Per-expert alpha of the FC1 activation"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
        "range": "[0.5, 2] or 4.0"
      "gemm1_beta":
        "meaning": "Per-expert beta of the FC1 activation"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
        "range": "[0, 1] or 25.0"
      "gemm1_clamp_limit":
        "meaning": "Per-expert FC1 clamp bound; None disables it"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
        "nullable": true
        "range": "[1, 16]"
      "activation_type":
        "meaning": "Selects one of the two FC1 activation formulas"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
        "range": "3 or 10"
      "routing_bias":
        "meaning": "Router bias, always None; routing is resolved"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "gemm1_bias":
        "meaning": "FC1 bias, absent in the declared domain"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "gemm2_bias":
        "meaning": "FC2 bias, absent in the declared domain"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "output1_scale_scalar":
        "meaning": "FC1 up scale, 1 in the domain and not applied"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
      "output1_scale_gate_scalar":
        "meaning": "FC1 gate scale, 1 in the domain, not applied"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
      "output2_scale_scalar":
        "meaning": "FC2 scale, 1 in the domain and not applied"
        "shape":

    "Output":
      "output":
        "meaning": "output_buffer overwritten and returned in a list"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        "dtype": "bf16"
    "Compute":
    - "Name": "Routing"
      "Math": "topk_ids is the pair (ids, scores): ids[t,s] names the expert of route\
        \ slot s of token t and scores[t,s] is its weight, for 0 <= t < token_count\
        \ and 0 <= s < slot_count.\nA route is valid when ids[t,s] is in [0, expert_count);\
        \ an invalid route selects no expert and contributes exactly 0. The construction\
        \ marks a masked or absent route with -1 and zeroes its score.\nSizes come\
        \ from the input shapes. In the declared domain slot_count = 8, token_count\
        \ is in [1, 8192], (hidden_dim, intermediate_dim, expert_count) is one of\
        \ (2048, 768, 128), (4096, 768, 128), (4096, 1536, 128), (7168, 256, 256),\
        \ and both feature sizes are multiples of nvfp4_block, so every scale block\
        \ is complete.\nArithmetic between the declared storage and quantization boundaries\
        \ is FP32, round-to-nearest-even, TF32 disabled; codes and scales enter at\
        \ their exact decoded values.\nNo formula reads the other interface arguments,\
        \ whose entries record the fixed values of the declared domain.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "ids":
          "meaning": "Expert index of each route slot"
          "shape": "ref:topk_ids.shape"
          "dtype": "int32"
        "scores":
          "meaning": "Routing weight of each route slot"
          "shape": "ref:topk_ids.shape"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Nvfp4 payload decode"
      "Math": "e2m1_level(code) for a 4-bit code is level[code mod 8] of level = (0,\
        \ 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6), negated when code >= 8, so code 8 is -0.\nOne\
        \ payload byte carries two consecutive channels of a row: q[j] holds channel\
        \ 2j in its low nibble q[j] mod 16 and channel 2j+1 in its high nibble floor(q[j]\
        \ / 16).\ndecode(q, sf) for a payload q whose last axis has length m/2 and\
        \ a scale sf whose last axis has length m/nvfp4_block:\n  decode(q, sf)[d]\
        \ = e2m1_level(nibble(d)) * fp32(sf[floor(d / nvfp4_block)])   for 0 <= d\
        \ < m\n  nibble(d) = q[floor(d/2)] mod 16 when d is even, floor(q[floor(d/2)]\
        \ / 16) when d is odd\nThe fp8_e4m3fn scale is used as its exact FP32 value\
        \ and a zero scale decodes its whole block to zero. Every axis other than\
        \ the last is independent and keeps its order.\nhidden_value = decode(hidden_states,\
        \ hidden_states_scale) for each token; the hidden-state scales are logical\
        \ row-major and carry no tiling.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "hidden_value":
          "meaning": "Decoded FP32 activation of one token"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Prepared weight layout"
      "Math": "The declared prepared layout stores the expert weight payloads and\
        \ scales out of logical row order. For a prepared tensor with nrow logical\
        \ rows:\n  half_row(l) = 2*l for l < nrow/2 and 2*(l - nrow/2) + 1 for l >=\
        \ nrow/2, applied to gemm1_weights only, whose stored rows interleave the\
        \ up and gate halves; gemm2_weights uses half_row(l) = l\n  row_perm(g) =\
        \ 32*floor(g/32) + 8*(g mod 4) + floor((g mod 32)/4)\n  prepared_row(l) =\
        \ row_perm(half_row(l))\nThe payload row and the scale row of one logical\
        \ row share that index. The weight scale bytes are in addition tiled into\
        \ 128-row by 4-column blocks: reading the stored scale tensor of one expert\
        \ as an (nrow/128, ncol/4, 32, 16) image, where ncol is its scale column count,\
        \ the multiplier of prepared row p and scale column j sits at [floor(p/128),\
        \ floor(j/4), p mod 32, 4*floor((p mod 128)/32) + (j mod 4)]. Every declared\
        \ geometry has nrow a multiple of 128 and ncol a multiple of 4, so the tiling\
        \ carries no padding.\n"
    - "Name": "Decoded expert weights"
      "Math": "w1[e][L,:] = decode over the row prepared_row(L) of gemm1_weights[e]\
        \ and of the un-tiled gemm1_weights_scale[e], for 0 <= L < 2*intermediate_dim,\
        \ so nrow = 2*intermediate_dim. Logical rows below intermediate_dim form the\
        \ up projection and the rest form the gate projection.\nw2[e][L,:] = the same\
        \ decode over gemm2_weights and gemm2_weights_scale, for 0 <= L < hidden_dim,\
        \ so nrow = hidden_dim and half_row(L) = L.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "w1":
          "meaning": "Decoded FC1 weight of one expert, logical rows"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count"
          - "out": "2*intermediate_dim"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
        "w2":
          "meaning": "Decoded FC2 weight of one expert, logical rows"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Fc1 per route"
      "Math": "For every valid route (t,s) with e = ids[t,s]:\n  up[t,s,i]   = sum_{h=0}^{hidden_dim-1}\
        \ hidden_value[t,h] * w1[e,i,h]                    for 0 <= i < intermediate_dim\n\
        \  gate[t,s,i] = sum_{h=0}^{hidden_dim-1} hidden_value[t,h] * w1[e,intermediate_dim+i,h]\n\
        Both are FP32 dot products over the whole hidden dimension, without bias and\
        \ without any output scale factor. up and gate exist only for valid routes;\
        \ an invalid route never reaches FC2 and contributes 0 to the output.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "up":
          "meaning": "FC1 up half of one valid route, pre-activation"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
        "gate":
          "meaning": "FC1 gate half of one valid route, pre-activation"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Generated activation parameters"
      "Math": "The supplied input construction uses activation_type 10 with gemm1_alpha\
        \ = 4 and gemm1_beta = 25; type 3 uses alpha in [0.5,2] and beta in [0,1].\
        \ Each parameter vector is constant across experts. Both branches are retained\
        \ because the dynamic domain specifies SiTU while nine fixed cases construct\
        \ type 3.\n"
    - "Name": "Clamp and activation"
      "Math": "alpha = gemm1_alpha[e] and beta = gemm1_beta[e] are per-expert values\
        \ used exactly.\nIf gemm1_clamp_limit is not None, with limit = gemm1_clamp_limit[e]:\n\
        \  up_c   = clamp(up, -limit, limit)\n  gate_c = min(gate, limit)\nThe gate\
        \ half is bounded from above only and receives no lower bound. If gemm1_clamp_limit\
        \ is None, up_c = up and gate_c = gate.\nIf activation_type = 10:\n  act =\
        \ alpha * tanh(gate_c / alpha) * sigmoid(gate_c) * (beta * tanh(up_c / beta))\n\
        Otherwise, which is activation_type = 3 in the declared domain:\n  act = gate_c\
        \ * sigmoid(alpha * gate_c) * (up_c + beta)\nsigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x)),\
        \ tanh is the hyperbolic tangent, and every product and sum is FP32.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "act":
          "meaning": "Activated FC1 value of one valid route"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Activation nvfp4 round trip"
      "Math": "A valid route (t,s) quantizes independent groups of nvfp4_block consecutive\
        \ channels, 0 <= b < intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block:\n  peak = max_{0<=u<nvfp4_block}\
        \ abs(act[t,s,b*nvfp4_block+u])\n  act_scale[t,s,b] = fp8_e4m3fn(clamp(fp32(peak\
        \ * fp32(1/e2m1_max)), 0, e4m3_max))\n  normalized = act[t,s,b*nvfp4_block+u]\
        \ / fp32(act_scale[t,s,b]) when act_scale[t,s,b] > 0, and 0 when it is 0\n\
        \  act_q[t,s,b*nvfp4_block+u] = e2m1_rne(normalized) * fp32(act_scale[t,s,b])\n\
        The reference multiplies by the rounded FP32 reciprocal of e2m1_max. The scale\
        \ cast is round-to-nearest-even after the clamp and read back exactly; a zero\
        \ scale forces its group to zero.\ne2m1_rne(x) keeps the sign of x, rounds\
        \ abs(x) to the nearest value of (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6), takes the level\
        \ with the even code index on a tie, and saturates to 6 when abs(x) > 6.\n\
        This quantize-dequantize is the declared boundary between the activation and\
        \ FC2: FC2 consumes act_q and never act.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "act_scale":
          "meaning": "E4M3 scale of one activation block of a route"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "block": "intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block"
          "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
        "act_q":
          "meaning": "Activation after the NVFP4 round trip"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Fc2 per route"
      "Math": "For every valid route (t,s) with e = ids[t,s] and 0 <= h < hidden_dim:\n\
        \  route_out[t,s,h] = fp32(bf16(sum_{i=0}^{intermediate_dim-1} act_q[t,s,i]\
        \ * w2[e,h,i])) * scores[t,s]\nThe FP32 sum covers the whole intermediate\
        \ dimension, is materialized as BF16 with round-to-nearest-even before the\
        \ routing weight is applied, and the product is formed in FP32. No bias and\
        \ no output scale factor is applied.\nFor a route that selects no expert,\
        \ route_out[t,s,h] = 0 for every h.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "route_out":
          "meaning": "BF16 FC2 result of one route times its weight"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Routing reduction and output"
      "Math": "For every token t and hidden channel h:\n  acc[t,h] = sum_{s=0}^{slot_count-1}\
        \ route_out[t,s,h]      in FP32, the summation order over routes being unspecified\n\
        \  output[t,h] = bf16(acc[t,h])                              round-to-nearest-even\
        \ into the declared storage dtype\nA token whose slots are all invalid keeps\
        \ acc = 0 and therefore output = 0, which is how empty and fully masked routing\
        \ are answered.\noutput is output_buffer, the same tensor object the caller\
        \ supplied: its incoming values are not read, all token_count*hidden_dim elements\
        \ are overwritten, that object is returned inside a one-element list, and\
        \ no other caller-visible storage changes. The input construction places output_buffer\
        \ inside a larger guarded allocation, so a write outside that view is observable.\
        \ Buffers an implementation keeps for itself are not outputs.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "acc":
          "meaning": "FP32 sum of the route contributions of a token"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    "Golden_reference":
      "Source": "KernelSchema@24d2b3d3ca9d4907c4e7efd9607cf78cfb1a52b2:kernel_wiki/aka-cuda-operators-20261030/operators/moe/nvfp4_fused_moe/problem/reference.py::Model.forward"
      "Tolerance":
        "output": "Source-only atol=.01 rtol=.05; default mismatch=0; output-write\
          \ mismatch=.001 rel_l2=.01"
      "Gap": "Comparator formulas and return/writeback mapping absent; source activation\
        \ declarations differ"
